purpose: Review recorded claim payments and reconcile settlement totals, preserving unresolved exceptions.
prerequisites: Authenticated Finance role and tenant scope
Existing claim and current settlement workflow
business_rules: Claims Managers approve and authorise; Finance executes and reconciles only.
Explicit user instruction is required for mutations; current backend gates remain authoritative.
approvals: Existing shared permission and execution gates; owning-service settlement authorisation is required before payment.
recovery: Ask for exact identifiers or ambiguous matches.
Refresh unknown payment outcomes before retry; do not repeat completed operations.
verification: Report verified backend outcomes only; registration does not prove live bank execution.
